# Frontman Public Read-Only API Resources

> Documentation and framework adapter metadata are available without sign-in or an API key. These resources cannot edit websites.

## Discovery

- [API catalog](https://frontman.sh/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset
- [OpenAPI description](https://frontman.sh/openapi.json): Public read contracts
- [Agentic resources](https://frontman.sh/.well-known/ard.json): ARD proposal listing published skills and API descriptions

## Public Reads

- [Documentation index](https://frontman.sh/search-index.json): GET returns an array of title, canonical url, and Markdown content for published searchable documentation. Search locally; this is not a general site or pricing index.
- [Latest adapter versions](https://api.frontman.sh/api/integrations/latest-versions): GET returns a versions map for @frontman-ai/nextjs, @frontman-ai/astro, and @frontman-ai/vite. Results may be cached for 30 minutes. Failed registry reads can be null; timed-out packages can be omitted.

## Product Access Boundaries

- [Authentication](https://frontman.sh/auth.md): Hosted sign-in, provider access, and WordPress permissions
- [Provider setup](https://frontman.sh/docs/api-keys/): Supported AI-provider connections
- [Local integration architecture](https://frontman.sh/docs/reference/architecture/): Framework development tools and authenticated product sessions

Public content reads are not a website-editing API. Hosted browser sign-in is not delegated OAuth authorization for third-party agents. Product user APIs require embedded-client bearer authentication. The marketing site does not serve a remote public MCP endpoint or an A2A agent service.
